comparison.objective: Install a circlip into a shaft groove and verify seating; candidate removes a retained electrical terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled ring spreading with pliers, square seating, and rotational verification versus two-blade tang depression and bimanual wire extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a seated circlip without overspread or twist; candidate requires terminal exit without wrong-contact release or housing/crimp damage. Candidate force limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate retention features, but circlip installation tests elastic spreading and groove seating rather than selective connector release.
